[quote=kolionia;61135666][spoiler=A City on Fire]Aug 25, 2027

This morning a mass rally was held for the People's Facist Eastornia-Kolionia Party or  PEKP. Those in attendance held up signs with racists and antisemitic signs while chanting racist and antisemitic slogans. When their leader, Hans von Frontent, came up to speak the crowd went wild. Hans's guards struggled to hold back the group of supports trying to push closer to be near their leader. He said very little of much importance, only false and offensive things about Wesserns, Jews, and people of color. At the end of the speech he said probably the only thing worth noting, "We have been oppressed for to long, no we take revenge." That night people broke into loyal Wessernians, Jews, people of color, and others' houses. They looted, they beat the inhabitants, and when they were done they barricaded the doors and set it on fire. It wasn't just houses that were targeted, churches, cathedrals, synagogues, diplomatic and political buildings for Wessern politicians and diplomats, shops, the list goes on and on. Unfortunately what they didn't anticipate was that the fires would spread to neighboring house, and thus the major cities of Kolio, Hanvas, Johuns, Gurtenburg, and others burned well into the night. The worst hit city was the capital of Kolio, the fires turned into a fire storm causing many people to suffocate. The next day Frontent made a speech on a pile of ashes that were once a Wessern's house. He proclaimed, "The Wesserns have done this, in their racist views they have tried to liquidate the entire Kolionian population!" He gestured to the surrounded ruins, "They will pay for their crimes, and we will rule as one Kolionian nation, united under one leader, united under one people. And today is the day that starts."
[/spoiler][/quote]
The Wesserns are truly evil, I can't believe they would build such flammable cities.
The Wesserns must pay for what they have done to all the Kolionians, the Wesserns must pay in blood for how they've abused their Kolionian victims.

[Spoiler=consulting ancestors.]
Around the 19th century, during the rule of his imperial majesty the Bhapac Náymur-Iálluk, or Naymurialluk in more Llyndorran language, the Altiplano, a region at the top of the mountains known as a very cold but also humid and very cloudy part of the region which shared history with Chimor for over 2000 years, it was only to be expected a region like taht should he integrated once again with cities such as Káìanuchû , Wámbli, Cháusáo etc...
The region around the year 1824, at the end of the colonial period and start of modern age, about 203 years ago, king Náymur-Iálluk would consult his ancestors mallùki(mummies) in the almighty temple of silver, he was companied by 48 courtiers who would bring with them food, cloth and drinks for the old rulers, Minchankaman, Nancenpinko, and Taycanamo, while his father Maiochan Chîmáy would also be among them as it always is in the tradition of mummies, where the greatest ancestors are deployed in the Temple while the father of the current ruler also exists, the other rulers also have mummies but are dispersed among mausoleums as a form of keeping dozens of mummified rulers is logistically impossible for a nation, feeding, offering cloth and talking to 4 is far more easy to keep than over 40.
The Bhapac entered into the room where the for stood still under the dome of glass above illuminating with the moonlight, the lamps of oil illuminated while small openings at the rooftops made air to circulate, the air impregnate with the offerings in coca leaf and teas of cocoa and Chicha. Every mummy would wear fine vicugna wool clothing and of very well woven cotton with golden bracelets, silver earrings with aquamarine jewelries and necklaces of tumbaga with kaskete shells pending off from them while their cloth as whole we're intricate with jewelries. The high sacerdot, the Willaq Umu Challko would also be company to his imperial majesty.
"[i]Give me nothing but truth and the words of ancestors Challko[/i]."
The Bhapac ordered to his sacerdot, who nodded in agreement while the courtiers started doing offerings, but then he stopped in front of his father and lowered his head in respected, he would not say a word, just stand there in respect, and only then started to speak.
"[i]Father hear me now[/i]".His voice sounding more lower in tone than normal it was.[i]"You had reformed Chanchán, the palace, and made the base for a thriving empire indeed, however"[/i].He looked up again staring at the mask covering his father already taken by darkness face, empty eyes which made a quite uncanny feeling of being observed and even judged, as he looked more and more the skin would look more dry."[I] I am afraid father, it is time for this puma to show his claws for the Altiplano people, who long forgotten how was the power of the lowland claws.[/i]
Challko would approach the mallùki with a cup of Chicha and grab the long dry fingers with preserved nails and put the cup as being hold,  then he remained kneel down at the front of the mummy, and then looked back to his Majesty,  a courtier would come and put a plate of silver in front of the mummy with  boiled potatoes sliced and a cob of maize.
As time passed, the Willaq Umu looked back to the bhapac, and came with a response.
[i]"He said, my Lord, he accepts your decision, and will guide you as he always did, not in voices you will hear but by decisions .[/i]
The bhapac smiled as the Willaq Umu answered, he then looked to Minchankaman the conqueror on the other side while the courtiers were ending to adjust the clothing of the conqueror as the bhapac started.
"[i]The 4th emperor of the second dynasty, who had conquered the western part of the Mapocho"[/i]...The bhapac would stop thinking before proceeding"But failed to conquer the east, ¿why? Taht is because, the Altiplano people were dancing with our troops..."He raised his hand in a quite contemplative state looking at the mummified body."[i]You see, the east had always been troublesome in history...the Fáratochanka for the Vikán, the ones they mitma'ed turned to the east and would forge their own kingdom...to not mention The Pìtipî our death rivals...truly, ironic."[/i]
Before Challko could say anything, The bhapac moved to the center and painted to every single mallùki.
"[i]All of You made your own conquests by your own, i shall make my own as well, not only brought prosperity and wealth to the land, i will be the one to bring land into our prosperity."[/i]For the first and last time a bhapac would kneel to someone."This is the Altiplano, the land i wish for, the land we all did,...".He looked to nothing, as if he was seeing the void itself and his crown made a shadow over his face covering his eyes, he smiled in a way even the courtiers and Challko seemed to retreat" [i]I want control, I want power, I want the Altiplano at one year my dream and so the ones we all wished for, will come true.[/i]"His Majesty got back raising his body once again and then looked at the Mummies of his predecessors."[I]I know i must not look back otherwise i will be the one placed behind and if i do not look at the past will just fall going to the future,[/i].
As observing Challko was surprised and white terrified as he looked his king act, he would in the interior of his mind say:
[i]"Afraid i am, his Majesty learnt how to communicate with the ancestors.[/i]"
Náymur next words, sounded more like a agreement and decision.
[i]Carry the legacy and carry the burden you all did, to expand the light of Chatay to even the farthest Altiplano, i now comprehend, you do not need to die to understand, the past, present and future, they are all [b]together.[/b][/i]"
[/Spoiler]
[Spoiler=Conquering Káìanuchû]
[i]"The peak gold Káìanuchû.[/i]" Náymur showed certain contemplat of the city architecture."[i]I see, they have positioned their cannons along and made barricades of trees,a waste of rare resource."[/i]
He looked to his side, general of vanguard Kusykuy was there waiting for orders.
[i]"our network of alliances made the markets of Káìanuchû to become more and more emptier as their agents bought most of their production." [/i]
The bhapac looked to the general with a smile, then pointed his kasakunpi to the city.
[i]"Excellent, ¿see those soldiers? ¿See those shots of cannon? order our men to position as a convex concave formation, once they advance we encircle them and leave the rest to our tamakits (maces), kampis(axes)and , our araka(slingshot) lines should make rain of stone hit them, ensure to not get any close to the city perimeter, unless you want to get exploded by cannons."[/i]He went silent as he adjusted his cape before continuing[I]"Our allies will ensure no reinforcement will arrive and will protect us from their valleys."[/i]
The general was interested in the bhapac whole strategy, he agreed but soon wondered what about his Majesty and asked:
[i]"What about you my Lord?[/i]"
The bhapac looked to the general once again, with a smile on his face, he took off his mantle and thrown at the general and so his crown.
[i]"Make them believe i am you, no needs to worry about me."[/i]
Before he could continue anything else, the bhapac left, companied by his royal guard of 12 men , armed with rifles revolvers and kasakunpis, and wearing ponchos.
As soon later, the bhapac entered the city, strangely emptied by soldiers and guarded only by a few watchful men. As he stepped into the plaza and crossed the market, a guard stopped him, hand resting near his weapon, and questioned their presence.
Disguised as a common traveler, the bhapac answered calmly:
[i]We are just a caravan of men from Cháusáo, my good sir. These are dangerous times, so we armed ourselves.[/i]
The place as a whole was historical, the plaza circular shaped, with old squared baths once used for community bathing, now used as fonts of decoration looking more majestic. Houses with red rooftops with windows protected by metallic bars and Adobe thick walls but short houses, the plaza proper was full of people wearing ponchos to protect against the cold climate and the markets would seel products into exorbitant prices. He looked back, the guard seemed quite anxious about something as he could not hide him shaking off his boots. The bhapac eyes narrowed as he noticed it, then he told to one of his disguised guards.
[i]"They clearly are afraid taht their forces will not be enough to stop our advance."[/i]
As the bhapac disguised advanced into the city roads, the local populace hiding behind the windows,  he would get into a cart selling some masks, the seller visually scared only received the 50 chayhuacs of his Majesty disguised in a quite scared form, it was enough to buy a whole festival cloth masks for him and the guards, his Majesty wore a mask of a puma, and his robes were robust and colored, the patterns were in shape of diamonds and felines depicted with spiral tails and squared shaped bodies.
As his Majesty touched a pillar in another plaza of the city, contemplating the stella displaying the appearance of the Chilla and Chatay,  his fingers long brown toned, his indicator passed with it golden ring feeling the irregular stone and it tips, for him it seemed as if he was touching the history itself.
[i]"¡Hey, you![/i]
A group of about 4 guards approached the 13 men, the bhapac would not look, just touch their commander shoulder with his right hand and mutter.
[i]"You know what to do.[/i]"
As he said this before leaving, the guard commander nodded agreeing, and then started moving as if they were guiding the bhapac to somewhere in the center of the city proper.
It was made with white stone, elegant shaped with a font in front, the bhapac would look at the outer guard with a calm touch over their should, stated with his eyes behind the mask, seemed shiny and dark as obsidian.
[i]"Do as you must."[/i]
As he ordered, the guards obeyed and opened the gates for them to enter, the commander entered alongside the bhapac and guided him until the doors of wood and then opened the doors.
[i]"Qirispai (governor) is on the second floor, follow the staircase go straight forward to the left.[/i]"
The bhapac nodded, the commander showed reverence by kneeling and saying in low respectful tone.
[i]"My Lord, i wish you good luck."[/i]
The bhapac would smile, but no one could see due the mask, but he was grateful, so entered with his guards, those who tried to alert the others and attack the invaders got themselves pierced by the guard kasakunpis. The halls were well decorated, as the 13 men moved calmly stepping over the cold polished stone floor and touching the walls of adobe decorated with jewelries.
Only once in the second floor, they started using the revolvers, Náymur would shoot only once, and it would be once in front of the office of the governor.
[i]"You better get outside Qirispai, do not try any thing foolish, you leave by the windows your own guards are against you, you get by using this door, i shoot you, make your choice."[/i]
The governor at the other side, seemed to move slowly paced, he ordered to Náymur.
[i]"How i now you will not shoot me once i am out?[/i]"
The bhapac would answer quite quickly.
[i]"Because i am not a man who likes senseless bloodshed, i do not plan to do any evil to your or your people as long you all surrender."[/i]
Qirispai was quite reluctant to move, he opened the door and pointed a gun to the bhapac, but his guards also pointed their halberd to the neck of Qirispai, who Náymur grabbed  his wrist and pulled to his side.
[i]"Enough of these games now Qirispai, i have nothing against you nor you people, all i want, is control, you can rule.[/i]He moved his head next to the governor ears" [i]As long you Swear your loyalty to me."[/i]
The governor seemed terrified, and frozen into the place, with some sweat falling of his forehead, the bhapac moved him alongside him to the outside of the mansion.
[i]"Now, i know i can not put a stop to your men, only you can am i right?[/i]"
Qirispai nodded, but still trying to escape the grab.
[i]"¿Why? Your armies have clear advantages and superiority at this point.[/i]
The bhapac behind his mask showed unhappy of such commentary, and pulled him closer then told him.
[i]"I can tell you, as i said , adverting senseless bloodshed it not what I want.[/i]He adjusted his mask, not going to show his appearance of course, but adjusting it to not fall off [i]"So make them surrender, as soon they see you under my grasp, they will panick and surrender."[/i]
Qirispai would show comprehension, but still rejecting to be grabbed.
[i]"Do not grab me, i am not yours."[/i]
The bhapac looked side to him, then touched his neck back, and corrected.
[i]"You are, so will be the mountains."[/i]
....
[/spoiler]
